name: 6'-chlorodiclazepam
summary: Ro07-5220 (6'-chlorodiclazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: Ro07-5220 (6'-chlorodiclazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: Ro07-5220 (6'-chlorodiclazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory gaps and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures. In overdose they can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的苯二氮平類藥物會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶空白與反應變慢。長期使用會導致依賴，突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。過量時可能使呼吸變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的苯二氮平类药物会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆空白与反应变慢。长期使用会导致依赖，突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。过量时可能使呼吸变慢。

fact.en: Its laboratory code Ro07-5220 marks it as one of the many benzodiazepines made by Roche, the company whose chemist Leo Sternbach discovered the class in the late 1950s.
fact.zh: 它的實驗室代號Ro07-5220顯示它是羅氏藥廠製造的眾多苯二氮平之一；該公司的化學家Leo Sternbach在1950年代後期發現了這一類藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它的实验室代号Ro07-5220显示它是罗氏药厂制造的众多苯二氮平之一；该公司的化学家Leo Sternbach在1950年代后期发现了这一类药物。
